CONTACT US
Self-service out of the box with Windows OS

Introducing Samsung Kiosk with Windows OS: a compact, eye-catching kiosk to provide reliable performance in any business location. With built-in Windows 10 IoT Enterprise OS, it supports enhanced compatibility with various 3rd party devices and services to integrate business operations.

Modular functionality to support any payment type

Boost every customer experience with the intuitive all-in-one payment and ordering system with no additional peripherals needed. Adopting a modular design, Samsung Kiosk1 KMC-C offers a variety of customer payment options including credit card, barcode, QR code and NFC, along with a built-in printer.

All-in-one solution with upgraded compatibility

Samsung Kiosk operating on Windows is an all-in-one solution without the need for an external PC. With Windows 10 IoT Enterprise OS, it enables flexible connection with versatile devices and services, making it suitable for a wide array of business use cases.

 
Robust yet stable performance

Powered by 11th Gen Intel® Core™ Processor2, Samsung Kiosk built on Windows OS features high-performance computing power for flexible, stable, and enhanced capabilities that deliver amazing and robust experiences to users in any business environment.

Compact and modern design

Samsung Kiosk is composed of a single display part and connection box, along with an optional stand. The design enables clean and convenient cable management while the grey-white colour and simple stand means the kiosk blends perfectly into any store interior with a stylish look.

Versatile solution for any scenario

For enhanced flexibility in any business environment, Samsung’s new kiosk offers three installation types – countertop, floor stand and wall-mounting* – along with hidden cabling and power strip, with no external PC needed either for optimised space saving.

Keep the screen clean

Thanks to Antimicrobial Coating3, Samsung Kiosk inhibits microbial growth to help protect against certain bacteria. This enables customers to stay focused on what’s on the screen with peace of mind.

 
Minimise accidents and risks
Shatterproof protection

Samsung understands that accidents happen. To protect students and educators, the Samsung Kiosk screen is wrapped in a proprietary shatterproof film4, ensuring the screen stays intact in the event of a break.

 

1Samsung Kiosk supports a fully integrated EMV cradle for a VeriFone terminal (P400) which varies by region and country.

2Embedded processor varies by model.

3To perform its antibacterial function, this product has been treated with the biocidal substance Zinc Pyrithione. Antibacterial properties do not protect users against bacteria and do not protect against viruses including Covid-19. Antimicrobial Coating is on the surface of the screen only and the effect may vary depending on the kind of bacteria or conditions of use. For further details regarding regional restrictions on the antimicrobial function, please refer to each country's Samsung.com website.

4A shatter-proof film is applied to the screen to help mitigate the hazard of shattering glass, but it does not protect the screen from physical impact.
